acceptance.command: With the operator present, acknowledge the warning, begin one bounded conservative interference profile, confirm the black lead-in, then exercise Stop before any temporal preset.
acceptance.proof: The operator observes the intended lead-in and pattern, Stop returns to a non-output state, and no output survives focus loss or package stop.

acceptance.command: Collect explicit operator feedback for stereo coverage, world/view lock, artifacts, comfort, and control usability.
acceptance.proof: The operator provides a bounded attended verdict and the receipt distinguishes subjective feedback from automated runtime evidence.

acceptance.command: Capture a bounded PID/package log window, stop only the target package, restore the exact prior property values, and verify cleanup.
acceptance.proof: Cleanup is complete with zero bounded package/system fatals, or the unit remains blocked with the exact failure evidence.

document.commit_policy: Keep raw device identities, logs, APKs, screenshots, and property snapshots in ignored local artifacts. Record only the minimum sanitized workflow projection unless a local validation receipt requires device identity.

instruction_surfaces.change_reason: Apply the existing serial-scoped Spatial SDK device-validation and explicit-opt-in feature policy.
Use the existing attended device sequence and safety stop conditions without changing the port contract.
Apply the existing Quest app-local, feature-activation, and evidence-boundary routing.

non_scope: Starting any visual output automatically from install, launch, a property, a preset selection, or restored UI state.
Running a temporal black/white or red strobe before panel-only launch, explicit warning acknowledgement, non-temporal interference output, and Stop behavior are confirmed.
Continuing any visual output after discomfort, unexpected instability, focus loss, a cleanup failure, or a package/system fatal.
Claiming medical efficacy, treatment, entrainment, device equivalence, exact compositor timing, or exact parity with the WebGL feedback-buffer trail.
Mutating the second connected Quest, changing Wi-Fi ADB, resetting ADB, changing power/proximity policy, or using Agent Board leases.
Changing application source in this unit; any defect that requires code changes blocks this device unit and moves to a separate source unit.
